reference.description: Founder’s four-screen mobile direction for AIO OFFICE: HOME, WORK, REPORTS, MORE (one 1536 × 1024 composite).

elements.label: ALL IN ONE ENTERPRISES INC. · search · bell · JL · JORDAN L. · AIO STAFF
elements.finding: Logo matches the approved staff header lockup (gold and black mark, ALL IN ONE / ENTERPRISES INC., no dot above the I). Search, alerts and identity are where the approved migration header puts them. The role line must come from the person’s role (FOUNDER or a staff role), never from a name.

elements.label: GOOD MORNING, JORDAN. · YOUR OPERATION AT A GLANCE. · Everything moving. Everything that needs you. All in one place.
elements.finding: Strong cinematic opener (black truck at the warehouse, golden hour) and the right promise. It takes about a third of the phone screen, so the attention cards sit low and the first real item is below the fold. The greeting uses a first name; it must come from the signed-in person.

elements.label: 3 · CLIENTS · NEED ATTENTION
elements.finding: Right idea, right place. It counts clients, while the contract lists items (an approval, a document, an expiring policy). The card should open the items, not just a number.

elements.label: 5 · DEADLINES · THIS WEEK
elements.finding: The only trace of the DEADLINES region. A count alone does not say what is due or for whom.

elements.label: 2 · BLOCKERS · REQUIRE INPUT
elements.finding: The only trace of the BLOCKERS region. Blockers group on whom they wait (client, staff, provider, document, approval, payment) — the card should lead to that list.

elements.label: WORK ACROSS AIO · Live activity across all services. · THIS WEEK
elements.finding: Shows 8 tiles: 7 of the 12 lanes plus INTAKE. Missing VEHICLES & FLEET, FACTORING, DRIVERS & CARRIERS, MECHANIC / MAINTENANCE, ROAD READY. “Live activity” is not true today: every office figure comes from the demo store.

anti_ai.note: “Live activity” claims live data that does not exist yet.

elements.label: Intake · 12 in progress
elements.finding: INTAKE is its own root in the dock, not a service lane. Migration items still reach HOME through NEEDS ATTENTION (blocked files, activation waiting).

anti_ai.note: INTAKE appears as a lane and as a dock root.

elements.label: Permitting · 8 active
elements.finding: Lane name is PERMITTING & AUTHORITIES.

elements.label: Filing (IFTA) · 14 open
elements.finding: Lane name is FILING & FUEL TAXES; IFTA is one workspace inside it.

elements.label: Compliance · 6 require attention
elements.finding: Right lane, right kind of figure (needs attention).

elements.label: Dispatch · 24 active loads
elements.finding: Right lane.

elements.label: Brokerage · 6 shipments
elements.finding: Right lane. The brokerage business line is paused today; the tile should say so rather than show activity.

elements.label: Insurance · 5 renewals
elements.finding: Right lane; renewals are the lane’s real attention source.

elements.label: Bookkeeping · 11 clients
elements.finding: Right lane. WORK draws the same lane as “5 clients” — two different figures for one lane.

elements.label: CLIENTS IN MOTION · Recent activity across your clients. · VIEW ALL
elements.finding: Good row design: client, service chips, status, time. Missing the next deadline and the blocking condition the contract asks for. The client badges are invented logo marks.

anti_ai.note: Each client badge is an invented emblem; real clients have no such marks. Use initials.

elements.label: Riverstone Logistics · IFTA · Bookkeeping · Compliance · Needs your approval · 2h ago
elements.finding: Sample client. “Needs your approval” is a real status family (APPROVAL_REQUIRED).

elements.label: Delta Hauling LLC · Permits · Insurance · Documents received · 4h ago
elements.finding: Sample client. Chip “Permits” should read PERMITTING & AUTHORITIES (or a short form the whole set uses).

elements.label: T&K Transport · Dispatch · IFTA · Filing ready · 6h ago
elements.finding: Sample client.

elements.label: RECENT ACTIVITY · Latest updates across AIO. · VIEW ALL · 4 events
elements.finding: Each line maps onto an event the code already records (filing prepared, intake started, document received, approval). The small gold bullets carry no meaning; an event-type mark would.

elements.label: HOME · INTAKE · WORK · REPORTS · MORE (HOME active)
elements.finding: Exactly the five AIO OFFICE roots in the canonical order, active root in the black-and-gold tile. The live app still shows FILING; that changes only in the implementation sprint.

elements.label: ALL IN ONE ENTERPRISES INC. · search · bell · JL · JORDAN L. · AIO STAFF

elements.label: GET THINGS DONE. · EVERY SERVICE. EVERY CLIENT. · Access all AIO workspaces and drive your operation forward.
elements.finding: Warm office scene that separates WORK from HOME’s road. Same height problem as HOME: the directory starts below the fold.

anti_ai.note: Potted plants and greenery carry no AIO meaning.

elements.label: SERVICE WORKSPACES · Manage active work across all AIO services.
elements.finding: The photographic directory is the page’s strongest idea and stays.

elements.label: Intake · 12 active
elements.finding: INTAKE has its own dock root; it is not one of the twelve lanes. Its slot goes to VEHICLES & FLEET.

anti_ai.note: INTAKE drawn as a lane card and a dock root.

elements.finding: Right lane and name. HOME draws the same lane as “8 active”. The photo has a fake “PERMITS” form.

anti_ai.note: Generated “PERMITS” heading and unreadable form text.

elements.label: Filing & Fuel Taxes · 14 open
elements.finding: Right lane and name. The photo (a jar on a stump by a mountain road) says nothing about filing and nearly repeats the Brokerage photo.

elements.label: Dispatch · 24 active loads

elements.label: Brokerage · 6 shipments

elements.label: Insurance · 7 active

elements.label: Bookkeeping · 5 clients

elements.finding: Right lane; its name is MECHANIC / MAINTENANCE. Tire-shop photo fits.

elements.label: NEED TO ASSIGN WORK? · Create a new task, case, or client project.

elements.label: REAL INSIGHTS. · STRONGER OPERATIONS. · Track performance, review history, and uncover what’s next.
elements.finding: Fitting desk-and-charts scene. Same height issue; the chart papers are generated.

elements.label: OVERVIEW · CLIENTS · SERVICES · FINANCIAL · EXPORTS
elements.finding: Five of the ten report domains. Missing FILING HISTORY, COMPLIANCE, DISPATCH / BROKERAGE, BOOKKEEPING, MIGRATION. FINANCIAL is FINANCIAL / REVENUE and is founder-class (staff only by grant).

elements.label: KEY METRICS · This period compared to last. · THIS MONTH
elements.finding: Period control in the right place.

elements.label: Clients · 48 · +12% · sparkline
elements.finding: A count of ACTIVE clients is supported (PREBUILT never counts). The +12% and the trend line need history the system does not keep.

elements.label: Filings Completed · 36 · +28% · sparkline
elements.finding: Supported: each filed quarter records when it was filed, so this period and the last can be compared. No report surface exists yet.

elements.label: Active Work Items · 62 · −8% · sparkline
elements.finding: The count is supported; the −8% and trend need history that is not kept.

elements.label: Revenue (Est.) · $48.2K · +14% · sparkline
elements.finding: No “estimated revenue” exists to show. The supported figure is collected service revenue — founder-class, staff only by grant — and today it is demo data. Never an estimate.

elements.label: SERVICE ACTIVITY · Work volume by service. · 8 bars
elements.finding: Partial data. Bars cover 7 lanes plus Intake / Migration (which belongs to the MIGRATION domain); five lanes are missing. The bars have no axis but carry their values, which is enough.

elements.label: FILING HISTORY · Recent submissions across all clients. · 4 rows
elements.finding: The data exists (filed quarters) but the domain is NOT STARTED as a surface. All four dates are in 2024 — two years old.

elements.label: CLIENT GROWTH · Active clients over time. · +24% since April · Apr–Sep bars
elements.finding: Not supported: activation dates are written but never read, so growth over time cannot be computed. The bars have no scale and no values.

anti_ai.note: Bars with no axis or values encode no data.

elements.label: Search tools, clients, documents...

elements.label: Clients · View and manage all client accounts.
elements.finding: Right entry and purpose.

elements.label: Documents & Vault · Access client documents and internal files.
elements.finding: Right entry. The page must tell staff-only, client-visible, generated and historical documents apart.

elements.finding: Right entry. Managing permissions is a founder act; staff see the team, not the role controls.

elements.finding: Right entry. Internal notes and client messages must look different.

elements.label: System Settings · Preferences, integrations and security.
elements.finding: Right entry; privileged areas inside it carry their gates.

elements.finding: Right entry. There is no live support today; training and SOPs exist.

decisions.title: How big the photographs are
decisions.question: Every page opens with a large photograph that takes about a third of the phone screen, so the first piece of real work sits below the fold. How much hero do you want?

options.option: Keep all four large
options.effect: Most cinematic; staff scroll before every task.

options.option: HOME keeps a shorter hero, the other three use a slim photo band
options.effect: HOME still greets; WORK, REPORTS and MORE show their content in the first screen.

options.option: Slim photo band on all four
options.effect: Most practical; HOME loses its welcome moment.

decisions.recommendation: HOME keeps a shorter hero (about 60% of today’s height, so the three attention cards sit in the first screen); WORK, REPORTS and MORE use a slim photo band.

decisions.title: What the three HOME cards do
decisions.question: HOME needs NEEDS ATTENTION, DEADLINES and BLOCKERS as real lists, not only numbers. How should they fit without making HOME long?

options.option: Cards become tabs of one list underneath
options.effect: Same three cards; tapping one shows its items (client, what is wrong, where to fix it). One list, three views.

options.option: Three separate lists below the cards
options.effect: Everything visible at once; HOME grows by about a screen.

options.option: Numbers only, open a separate page
options.effect: Shortest HOME; the next action is one tap further away.

decisions.recommendation: Cards become tabs of one list underneath, showing the top five items of the selected card.

decisions.title: Quick actions on HOME
decisions.question: The drawing has no quick actions. Where should they go?

options.option: Phone: behind a “+” in the header · tablet and desktop: a visible row / column
options.effect: The phone’s first screen stays for attention (contract order); wider screens show the actions in parallel.

options.option: A row of four under the attention list on every device
options.effect: Always visible; pushes the work summary down on phones.

options.option: None on HOME
options.effect: Cleanest; staff go through WORK and INTAKE.

decisions.recommendation: Phone: a “+” in the header opens four role-aware actions — START MIGRATION, MY WORK, VIEW DEADLINES, MESSAGE A CLIENT (plus CREATE INVOICE and NEW LEAD for people with the billing or CRM grant). Tablet: a row after recent activity. Desktop: the top of the context column.

decisions.title: What each WORK card shows
decisions.question: Each lane card shows one number today. What should a card tell you at a glance?

options.option: One number, as drawn
options.effect: Simple; says little about urgency.

options.option: Needs-attention count plus a BLOCKED marker when the lane has one
options.effect: Cards point at what to do first; lanes that cannot report say NOT CONNECTED YET.

options.option: No numbers until they are production data
options.effect: Truthful; the grid feels static.

decisions.recommendation: Needs-attention count plus a BLOCKED marker, taken from the lane’s own summary (the same figure HOME shows). Lanes without that data say NOT CONNECTED YET; VEHICLES & FLEET says NO STAFF SCREEN YET.

decisions.title: The “NEED TO ASSIGN WORK?” banner
decisions.question: Creating a case or “client project” does not exist yet, and assigning is for managers. What should the banner at the bottom of WORK be?

options.option: Replace it with MY WORK
options.effect: Shows what is assigned to you — something that exists today.

options.option: Keep it for later
options.effect: Draws a feature the system cannot do yet.

options.option: Remove it
options.effect: Cleaner page.

decisions.recommendation: Replace it with a MY WORK strip near the top of WORK (assigned to me, due soon), and keep “create case” out until it exists.

decisions.title: Repairing the photographs
decisions.question: Several photos contain fake text (PERMITS, DOT, INSURANCE, garbled ledgers), an invented logo on the MORE notebook, a masked driver, and two near-identical road shots. How should we fix them?

options.option: Controlled asset pass: same subjects, clean high-resolution versions
options.effect: Keeps your choices; removes the AI tells.

options.option: Reuse existing approved photos where they fit, new ones for the rest
options.effect: Faster and consistent with IFTA (fleet yard for VEHICLES & FLEET, light-trail road for FILING, AIO truck for DISPATCH).

options.option: Keep them as drawn
options.effect: Fastest; the artifacts would ship.

decisions.recommendation: Reuse the four approved plates that fit, and run a controlled asset pass for the rest with the same subjects and no legible generated text.

decisions.title: The four headline numbers on REPORTS
decisions.question: Of the four drawn numbers, only some can be backed: client growth and the percentage changes cannot be computed, and “estimated revenue” does not exist. What should the overview lead with?

options.option: Only figures we can back, no trend lines yet
options.effect: ACTIVE CLIENTS, FILINGS FILED (with last period), ACTIVE WORK, COLLECTED REVENUE (founder / finance only). Unbacked ones show a clear “not connected yet”.

options.option: Keep the drawn tiles and label them “sample”
options.effect: Looks finished; teaches staff to ignore numbers.

options.option: Hide the overview until data is production-backed
options.effect: Truthful; REPORTS looks empty.

decisions.recommendation: Lead with the four figures we can back, no sparklines until history exists, and an honest “not connected yet” panel where CLIENT GROWTH is drawn.

decisions.title: How the ten report areas are reached
decisions.question: The drawing has five tabs; REPORTS has ten areas. How should people move between them?

options.option: Phone: overview plus a list of the ten areas; desktop: a side list
options.effect: All ten reachable, nothing squeezed.

options.option: Ten scrolling tabs
options.effect: Familiar; most tabs hide off-screen on a phone.

options.option: Group into four tabs
options.effect: Compact; areas get buried inside groups.

decisions.recommendation: Phone: OVERVIEW first, then a list of all ten areas with their state; tablet: two rows of tabs; desktop: a side list beside the report.

decisions.title: REPORTS for staff without the reporting grant
decisions.question: Reporting is founder-class; staff see it only by grant. The dock must keep exactly five items. What does a staff member without the grant see on REPORTS?

options.option: Keep the tab; show only the areas they are granted, or a clear “ask a founder for access” page
options.effect: Same dock for everyone; no hidden surprises.

options.option: Hide REPORTS for them
options.effect: Breaks the fixed five-item dock.

decisions.recommendation: Keep the tab for everyone. Staff see only the areas they are granted; with none, a clear “reporting is by grant” page.

decisions.title: Grouping the MORE directory
decisions.question: MORE needs eleven entries (three are missing: GROWTH / CRM, BILLING, ACCOUNT). One long list or groups?

options.option: Four groups
options.effect: CLIENTS & RECORDS (Clients, Documents & Vault, Messages) · BUSINESS (Growth / CRM, Billing, Service Catalog) · PEOPLE & NETWORK (Team & Staff, Mechanic Network) · SYSTEM (System Settings, Help & Support, Account).

options.option: One list of eleven in canonical order
options.effect: Simple; long on a phone.

options.option: Two groups (Business · Office)
options.effect: Fewer headings; less meaningful.

decisions.recommendation: Four groups, with the group names open for your wording. The heading “ADDITIONAL TOOLS” goes.

decisions.title: The “NEED HELP?” card
decisions.question: It repeats the Help & Support row right above it. Keep it?

options.option: Remove it
options.effect: One way to reach help.

options.option: Keep it as the only help entry and drop the row
options.effect: Friendlier; breaks the directory pattern.

decisions.recommendation: Remove the card; Help & Support stays as an entry.

decisions.title: Where ACCOUNT lives
decisions.question: ACCOUNT (your own profile) belongs in MORE. Should the avatar in the header also open it?

options.option: Both: MORE entry and avatar menu open the same page
options.effect: Expected behaviour; one page.

options.option: MORE only
options.effect: Strict; the avatar does nothing.

decisions.recommendation: Both open the same MORE → ACCOUNT page.

decisions.title: The name and role in the header
decisions.question: The drawing shows “JORDAN L. · AIO STAFF”; the approved migration masters show “ALEX R. · STAFF”. What should the authority set show?

options.option: One sample person across all AIO authorities, role line from the role
options.effect: Consistent; FOUNDER shows as FOUNDER for founders.

options.option: Name only, no role line
options.effect: Simpler; hides who has founder powers.

decisions.recommendation: One sample person across the AIO authority sets, and a role line that reads the person’s role (FOUNDER, or the staff role).

decisions.title: The desktop and tablet frame
decisions.question: There is an approved AIO OFFICE desktop and tablet frame from the migration work (header bar, left side menu on desktop, bottom dock on tablet). Use it for all four pages?

options.option: Yes, with WORK in place of FILING
options.effect: One consistent office on every device.

options.option: Design a new desktop frame
options.effect: Fresh; two frames for one office.

decisions.recommendation: Yes: the approved frame, with WORK replacing FILING in the side menu and dock.

decisions.title: Making your four screens the AIO creative direction
decisions.question: The studio’s design pipeline needs an AIO creative-direction profile before any new AIO page family is generated (only IFTA was exempt). Should your four-screen language become that profile?

options.option: Yes: your four screens are the basis of the AIO profile
options.effect: Every later AIO page inherits this look.

options.option: Only for AIO OFFICE
options.effect: Other AIO families may diverge.

decisions.recommendation: Yes: record your four-screen language (photography, black-and-gold dock, ivory surfaces, editorial headlines) as the AIO creative-direction profile.
